title: ICT Media Technology Essentials
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT ICT MEDIA TECHNOLOGY ESSENTIALS
outcomes: Students will apply principles of visual communication and design to create digital media projects using industry-standard software and emerging technologies.
Students will design and develop interactive applications and content that integrate text, graphics, animation, sound, video, and digital imaging for diverse delivery platforms.
Students will demonstrate foundational skills in Web design, multimedia production, and gaming by producing creative projects that reflect best practices in digital media.

missing_explained.why: Not printed in this section; the section prints CIS 170 (Introduction to Computer Games Programming) instead, which may be the same course under a different subject code.

notes: The catalog prints CIS 170 'Introduction to Computer Games Programming' in this certificate, while the closed list has CS170 'Computer Game Programming and Logic I'; recorded CIS 170 as a catalog addition. A reviewer should check whether these are the same course (CS 170 'Introduction to Computer Games' also appears in the Apple Coding Developer section).
